name: service-monitor
description: What every process of a service logs, how it is doing, and the machine under it: a SQLite store with a Fastify plugin, and the React panels that read it.

scripts.check-types: npm run check-types -w service-monitor-backend && npm run check-types -w service-monitor-frontend && npm run check-types -w service-accounts-backend && npm run check-types -w service-accounts-frontend
scripts.clean: npm run clean -w service-monitor-backend && npm run clean -w service-monitor-frontend && npm run clean -w service-accounts-backend && npm run clean -w service-accounts-frontend
scripts.test: npm run test-only && npm run check-types && npm run eslint && npm run prettier
scripts.test-only: npm run test-only -w service-monitor-backend && npm run test-only -w service-monitor-frontend && npm run test-only -w service-accounts-backend && npm run test-only -w service-accounts-frontend
scripts.tsc: npm run tsc -w service-monitor-backend && npm run tsc -w service-monitor-frontend && npm run tsc -w service-accounts-backend && npm run tsc -w service-accounts-frontend
